name: mc-monthly-report-builder
description: Member Care Monthly Report Builder: one offline HTML file built from js/ and dt/

scripts.build: mkdir -p out && cd js && python3 combine.py > ../out/combined_main.js && node --check ../out/combined_main.js && bash assemble_standalone.sh ../out/mc.html
scripts.test: node test/unit.cjs && node test/rules.cjs && node test/recon_unit.cjs && node test/recog.test.cjs && node test/atttpl.cjs && node test/onepage.cjs && node test/supply.cjs
